method: Mirror image across vertical mirror (right side)
steps: Vertical mirror MN on the right: sequence order reverses and each character is flipped left-right
uP23AB -> flipped B, A, flipped 3, flipped 2, flipped P, u
Option A keeps 2,3 unflipped; B inverts A (water image); D keeps 2 unflipped; C shows all flipped correctly

method: Positional rotation of symbols between figures
steps: Positions: TL, middle-centre, middle-right, BL, bottom-middle, BR
Fig1->Fig2 and Fig3->Fig4: TL<-BL, MC<-BR, MR<-MC, BL<-TL, BM<-MR, BR<-BM
Fig2->Fig3: TL<-BR, MC<-MR, MR<-MC, BM<-TL, BR<-BM, BL gets a new symbol (K replaced by T)
Apply Fig2->Fig3 rule to Fig4 (T,8,L,W,2,X): TL X, MC L, MR 8, BM T, BR 2, BL new symbol (9)
Option D: X / L 8 / 9 T 2 matches

method: Mirror image across vertical mirror (right side)
steps: Vertical mirror MN on the right: order reverses and each character flips left-right
yReA4kL -> flipped L, flipped k, flipped 4, A, flipped e, flipped R, flipped y
A inverts A (water image), C shows y rotated (not mirrored), D leaves L unflipped; B matches

method: Paper folding: unfold by reflecting across fold lines
steps: Right half folded onto left, then top folded onto bottom; cuts made on bottom-left quarter
Square touching the horizontal fold becomes a tall rectangle at the left edge; mirrored to right edge
Circle above triangle (apex up) at bottom reflects to triangle apex-down above circle at top
Unfolding vertical fold duplicates to both sides of centre: option D

method: Figure series: cyclic movement of letters among positions
steps: Positions TL, TR, centre, BL, BR
Each step: TR<-TL, TL<-centre, centre<-BL, BL<-BR, BR<-TR
Fig4 (O,P,S,D,U) -> TL S, TR O, centre D, BL U, BR P = option D
check_code:
figs=[("D","S","U","P","O"),("U","D","P","O","S"),("P","U","O","S","D"),("O","P","S","D","U")]
step=lambda f:(f[2],f[0],f[3],f[4],f[1])  # TL,TR,C,BL,BR
for a,b in zip(figs,figs[1:]): assert step(a)==b
opts={"A":("S","D","P","U","O"),"B":("U","O","S","P","D"),"C":("S","O","U","P","D"),"D":("S","O","D","U","P")}
r=step(figs[-1])
assert r==opts["D"]
for k in "ABC": assert r!=opts[k]
